rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the review-progress 500: /app/backend/refinement_routes.py:77 `class ReviewProgress(BaseModel): route: str = Field(min_length=1)` — Pydantic then rejects extra attributes, so payload.label at line 528 raised AttributeError. The frontend ReviewProgressTracker (per review-request notes) posts {route, label}; label was persisted at the storage layer (line 528 writes last_label) but never reachable due to the model omission. Fix: add `label: str = ""` to the model. Reproduction: `curl -X POST $BASE/api/review-mode/progress -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --cookie-jar cj --cookie cj -d '{"route":"/x","label":"y"}'` after admin login -> 500 before fix, 200 {"status":"saved"} after fix. Mitigation applied: single-line model addition + regression test test_review_progress_full_cycle.
